inlines.v: APPROBA'TION, noun [Latin approbatio. See Proof and Prove.] 1. The act of approving; a liking; that state or disposition of the mind, in which we assent to the propriety of a thing, with some degree of pleasure or satisfaction; as, the laws of God require our approbation 2. Attestation; support; that is, active approbation or action in favor of what is approved. 3. The commendation of a book licensed or permitted to be published by authority, as was formerly the case in England.
